page: Microsoft Azure D4ds_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Ddsv7 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor with 4 dedicated vCPUs, derived from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading. The CPU operates at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz and is equipped with a large 480 MB L3 cache. The instance includes 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server is bundled with 236 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. The Intel processor supports advanced instruction sets, including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX_tile, AMX_int8), alongside hardware-accelerated cryptography (AES, VAES, SHA_ni). No GPUs are included in this configuration.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-threaded performance, with gzip compression reaching top-tier levels at 36.47 GB/sec and bzip3 single-threaded decompression performing strongly at 15.05 GB/sec. However, multi-core scaling is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng multi-core and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression results. Memory read bandwidth is average, while uncached write bandwidth is weaker. This hardware profile is well-suited for general-purpose workloads, moderate database operations, static web serving, and single-threaded processing tasks that benefit from high clock speeds and local NVMe storage.
description: The Microsoft Azure D4ds_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine from the Ddsv7 family, powered by a dedicated 4.2 GHz Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor. It features 4 vCPUs, 16.0 GB of RAM, and 236 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this x86_64 instance supports advanced CPU instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel AMX for matrix operations. Benchmark results show exceptional single-threaded performance, highlighted by top-tier gzip compression and strong bzip3 decompression, though multi-core scaling and uncached memory write speeds are relatively weak. With its balanced resource allocation and fast local storage, the D4ds_v7 is suited for general-purpose applications, static web serving, and moderate database workloads.
